common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated 2D top-down fantasy card-game art review for Yanzhou. Unified art direction: dark burgundy (#4a1724), antique muted gold (#ac8c4e), black-brown wood (#261a15), restrained ivory paper (#e7d8b7). Exquisite hand-inked contours, fine engraved hatching, thin opaque gouache color, tactile worn materials, elegant occult workshop. Orthographic 90-degree overhead, absolutely no camera perspective or photorealistic 3D. Clear small-scale silhouette; ornament finer than the main shapes. A subtle circular broken-ring-and-diamond seal is the shared ornamental motif, never readable occult sentences. Warm light from upper left, modest contact shadow. No watermark, logos, extra interface, annotations, mood-board labels, people, hands, skulls, or unrequested objects. This is one component for independent review, never assemble a full game board.

assets.name: 桌面
assets.subject: Draw ONLY an empty tabletop material study, wide landscape 3:2. Black-brown walnut wood around a dark burgundy woven cloth with subtly irregular edges and four quiet antique-gold embroidered corner details. The cloth covers the central 75 percent. Cloth center is very low contrast and empty. Slight frayed stitching, a tiny edge crease and aged material grain; no stain in center, no grid, no giant sigil, no cards, tools, counters or text. Whole cloth visible with margin. Refined 2D hand-painted board-game background.

assets.name: 卡牌正面
assets.subject: Draw ONE complete upright portrait physical playing-card front centered, aspect ratio of card 9:13, generous transparent padding around it. Ivory paper body, thin double antique-gold border, burgundy corner inlays with restrained etched filigree. Exact hierarchy: small defense square symbol at upper left, Chinese short title '护盾' at top, central engraved golden shield with a dark burgundy enamel diamond, fixed clean effect zone at bottom with the exact short line '◇ +4' and smaller line '✦ +1'. Main shield occupies the middle 55 percent. Do not add other words, stat badges, costs, numbers or objects. All card edges fully visible, face perfectly parallel to image plane.

assets.name: 卡背
assets.subject: Draw ONE complete upright portrait playing-card BACK, same 9:13 physical proportions as a refined ivory-front fantasy card, centered with generous transparent padding. Dark burgundy cloth-paper laminate, thin aged-gold double border, symmetrical engraved botanical scrolls kept near edges. A memorable central gold circular broken-ring seal containing a tall diamond; little gold corner knots. Plain dark breathing space separates the central emblem and ornate edge. No text, numbers, portrait, distinct card ability, material icon, rarity or type information. Entire back fully visible, no other objects.

assets.name: 守护法器
assets.subject: Draw ONE guardian artifact, a palm-sized heavy shield-shaped antique brass enamel amulet lying flat and fully visible. Squat strong silhouette, worn gold metal bevels, deep burgundy enamel center, ivory inlaid small central diamond, short circular suspension eye without chain. Subtle circular seal engraved along the rim. Small exact contact shadow beneath, no stone plinth, no fabric or other props, no progress meter or text. Keep about 15 percent transparent padding.

assets.name: 施法法器
assets.subject: Draw ONE spellcasting artifact lying flat: an elongated faceted dark garnet-crystal spindle held inside two slender concentric antique-brass rings, a small brass finial at top and bottom. Delicate but readable overhead silhouette contrasts with the squat guardian shield. Ivory and pale-gold reflected facets, tiny restrained etched ring details. No bright neon glow, aura, pedestal, chain, cards, progress meter or text. Object fully visible with 15 percent transparent padding, faint contact shadow.

assets.name: 筹码
assets.subject: Create ONE isolated component-set image containing THREE clearly separated small stacks of circular physical counters arranged horizontally at equal scale, each with just 3 to 4 shallow visible layers. All have the same aged-gold ridged rim, and all tops visible from exact overhead using tiny offset lower layers. Left: dark burgundy enamel with an ivory HEART emblem for life. Middle: muted slate-gray-blue enamel with an ivory DIAMOND emblem for armor. Right: warm aged-gold/amber inset with an ivory FOUR-POINT STAR emblem for spell count. Symbols only, absolutely no numbers or text. Shared detailed crafted style, modest shadow, ample transparent padding; do not add chips outside those 3 piles.

assets.name: 铜灯
assets.subject: Draw ONE compact antique-brass oil lamp seen from exact overhead, lying/standing naturally on an invisible horizontal table. Round low oil reservoir, short handle and spout, small warm amber flame, engraved burgundy enamel accent and subtle worn surface. Entire silhouette fully visible, restrained local illumination only, not a huge bloom. No candle group, table, page, cards or other props, no text. Generous transparent padding and soft contact shadow.

assets.name: 封蜡试剂瓶
assets.subject: Draw ONE small stoppered glass reagent bottle lying flat on an invisible tabletop, exact overhead view. Short rounded body, narrow neck, a modest amount of translucent deep wine-red liquid, antique-gold wire collar and burgundy wax seal stamped with a tiny abstract diamond-ring mark. Label-free clear glass, hand-painted warm highlights, quiet ink contours. Entire object visible with ample transparent padding. No text, cards, herbs, materials, extra bottles or sparkles.

assets.name: 札记与笔具
assets.subject: Draw ONE small decorative stationery grouping from exact overhead: a closed thin black-brown leather notebook with a worn burgundy corner, antique-gold embossed broken-ring seal, slightly uneven ivory paper edges, and one short brass-nib pen resting diagonally beside it without covering the book. No readable writing or letters, no open pages, no cards, extra objects or workbench. Entire grouping visible and generously padded on transparent background, hand-painted aged materials and modest contact shadow.

assets.name: 光影与反馈
assets.subject: Draw ONE isolated lighting-and-feedback material study, landscape 3:2: close-up of empty dark burgundy woven cloth, ONE tiny antique-gold three-segment progress ring lying flat at center with exactly one segment quietly illuminated, and one small engraved diamond-shaped marker to its right catching warm light. Light falls from upper left, soft amber illumination transitions to deep burgundy shadow, small shapes stay legible. Calm hand-painted 2D look, no complete game board, cards, artifacts, UI panels, text, numbers, labels or distracting particles. This is a local optical detail study, not an assembled scene.

corrections.prompt: Edit this individual bottle concept. Preserve burgundy, antique gold, black-brown and ivory palette and wax seal motif. Correct the viewpoint: a flat 2D hand-inked gouache inventory sprite viewed exactly 90 degrees from above, bottle LYING FLAT on its back, long axis vertical on the page. NO view into the cork top; cork is a simple rectangular planar silhouette, neck is rectangular, body is a flattened round bulb. Its broad side faces directly up, no perspective ellipse, no isometric rendering, no horizon. Make material shading restrained and illustrative with ink contours, not a photoreal 3D product render. Keep everything within a transparent cutout. Eliminate broad surrounding glow/background. One complete bottle only, no text. Preserve transparency.

promptAssembly: common + "\nSubject-specific brief: " + assets[n].subject; corrections use their full prompt verbatim.
